import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    size='weight_grams',
    alpha=0.6,
    data=df,
    legend='full'
)
plt.xscale('log')
plt.yscale('log')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels (log scale)')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD) (log scale)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type and Weight')
plt.legend(
    title='Sensor Type\n(Bubble size = weight in grams)',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1),
    loc='upper left'
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
